sources.title: CoreML Export | huggingface/segment-anything-2 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The CoreML export system transforms SAM 2 models into Apple's CoreML format, allowing efficient execution on iOS and macOS devices. The conversion process decomposes the monolithic SAM 2 model into three separate CoreML models that work together to perform image segmentation.
